alt.en: Two samples each contain two rows of two coordinates. Multiplying each row by the same 2 by 3 matrix yields two rows of three scores per sample. The first row produces 2, 1, minus 1.
alt.zh-hans: 两个样本各有两行，每行两个坐标。每一行都乘同一张二行三列矩阵，每个样本得到两行三项分数。第一行的结果是 2、1、负 1。

caption.en: Figure 5.1 — One shared matrix changes coordinates into score channels; samples and positions stay separate.
caption.zh-hans: 图 5.1 — 同一张矩阵把坐标变成分数通道；样本与位置仍各自保留。

credit.en: Original diagram and teaching values, CC BY-SA 4.0.
credit.zh-hans: 本书原创图示与教学数值，CC BY-SA 4.0。

flow.en: Choose a sample, then a position, then a coordinate.
flow.zh-hans: 先选样本，再选位置，最后选坐标。

flow.en: Sum over C only. Do not combine samples or positions.
flow.zh-hans: 只沿 C 维相乘求和，不把不同样本或位置混在一起。

flow.en: K names the ordered candidates Paris, Lyon, other. These scores are not probabilities.
flow.zh-hans: K 对应有固定顺序的候选：巴黎、里昂、其他。这些分数还不是概率。
